camel_example: aliyun rds ListUserBackupFiles --region cn-hangzhou --Status CheckSuccess --Comment BackupTest --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmy0000' --OssUrl 'https://0000.oss-ap-0000.aliyuncs.com/backup_qp.xb' --BackupId 'b-kwwvr7v8t7of0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Tags 'key1:value1'
description_en: Queries the details about the full backup files that are imported into an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询所有已导入至RDS的用户备份的详情
kebab_example: aliyun rds list-user-backup-files --status CheckSuccess --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --comment BackupTest --backup-id b-kwwvr7v8t7of0000 --oss-url https://0000.oss-ap-0000.aliyuncs.com/backup_qp.xb --tags key1:value1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUserBackupFiles

parameters.help_en:
The status of the full backup file. Valid values:

*   **Importing**: The full backup file is being imported.
*   **Failed**: The full backup file fails to be imported.
*   **CheckSucccess**: The full backup file passes the check.
*   **BackupSuccess**: The full backup file is imported.
*   **Deleted**: The full backup file is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
通过用户备份文件的状态查询目标用户备份。取值：
* **Importing**：导入中。
* **Failed**：导入失败。
* **CheckSuccess**：校验通过。
* **BackupSuccess**：导入成功。
* **Deleted**：已删除
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the full backup file.

> The system implements a fuzzy match based on the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
通过备注信息查询目标用户备份。
>您可输入目标用户备份的部分备注信息进行模糊匹配
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the full backup file
parameters.help_zh: 通过用户备份ID查询目标用户备份
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The URL from which you can download the full backup file that is stored as an object in an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket. For more information about how to obtain the URL, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39607.html
parameters.help_zh: 通过用户备份文件的OSS下载地址查询目标用户备份。如何获取用户备份文件的OSS下载地址，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39607.html
parameters.name: oss_url

parameters.help_en: The tag that is added to the full backup file
parameters.help_zh: 通过标签信息查询目标用户备份
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to obtain the ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
